author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Adapt-FusedGeom: Two-View Equal-Quota Graph (k=48, geomean fusion)
abstract: Dual BRBG with equal-quotas balanced kNN built from fused per-batch distances using geometric mean of residualized-PC and ComBat-PCA64 per-batch distances (fallback to min if one is missing). Tests whether requiring agreement from both views boosts ARI/NMI without losing mixing.
